role: REFERENCE: completedCount and the gate order (ACTIVE profile, closure restriction, block, world) that the public trust read repeats
GATE: a block in either direction
body:
select exists(select 1 from private.account_blocks x where x.active
 and ((x.blocker_account_id=a and x.blocked_account_id=b) or (x.blocker_account_id=b and x.blocked_account_id=a)));

role: GATE: an account under a closure restriction
body:
select exists(select 1 from private.account_closure_requests r where r.account_id=a
 and r.state in('READY','EXECUTING','FAILED','CLOSED'));

role: GATE: the TEST / REAL world of two accounts
GATE: the world of one account (PKG-029e keeps the owner's accounts in TEST while testing)
body:
select case when coalesce(private.account_lineage(p_account_id), 'UNCLASSIFIED')
                in ('DEV_ACCEPTANCE_QA','SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE_FIXTURE','OPERATOR',
                    -- PKG-029e, owner decision 2026-09-21 ("dok testiramo"): the owner's own accounts share the
                    -- test world while testing. Take these two out again before real users arrive.
                    'OWNER_PERSONAL','OWNER_BUSINESS') then 'TEST' else 'REAL' end;

role: GATE: the lineage row behind the world
body: select coalesce((select l.lineage from private.account_lineage_v5 l where l.account_id = p_account_id), 'UNCLASSIFIED');
